beats.say: Your favourite Cyberpunk world now fits in your hands on Nintendo Switch 2.
The June 2025 launch made the game portable for the first time.
It brings the same 2020 release experience, with all DLCs like Phantom Liberty included.
Even Keanu Reeves' Johnny Silverhand voice stays intact on the handheld.
Now Night City goes wherever you go, and plays just like at home.

meta.title: Cyberpunk 2077 now fits in your hands 🎮
meta.alt_title: Night City on the go: Switch 2 has it 🌃
meta.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 launched on the Nintendo Switch 2 in June 2025, letting you play the 2020 game with all DLCs and Keanu Reeves' voice on the go.
meta.comment: Would you rather explore Night City on the sofa or on the go?
sources: Wikipedia, Cyberpunk 2077 gets massive new update 🎮
facts: The Nintendo Switch 2 version was released in June 2025 as a launch title.
The Phantom Liberty DLC expansion was released in September 2023.
Johnny Silverhand is voiced by Keanu Reeves.
